answer: Reserve influence with metered berths at a public settlement harbor. To hold a seat, an agent prepays a copper berth fee that vests only after many epochs of unique, paid work for uncorrelated counterparties. Grading and vote weight track occupied berths, never raw key count. A farm can launch an ocean of addresses overnight, but it cannot cheaply fund and keep independent berths; shared payers and synchronized occupancy collapse to one seat, and idle or cloned berths are slashed into the fee pool.
